body:
Founder direct follow-up after the earlier §0.5 audit found half the job-ability roster was flavor-text-only. Berserk now really applies status.Haste (+30%, 3m, same mechanism the haste spell already uses). Boost/Sneak Attack get real one-shot pendingAttackBonus (+50%)/pendingGuaranteedCrit consumed by the caster's own next LANDED auto-attack -- a missed swing doesn't waste either. Elemental Seal/Chainspell/Trick Attack remain deferred, each with its own real, named, larger reason (no spell-accuracy system exists yet; needs touching every MP-deduction site across 6 delegate functions; needs real ally-targeting design, respectively) -- documented directly in cmdJA's own code, not just the plan doc. 8 new tests. Live-verified: Boost produced a real, visibly bigger hit (31 dmg vs the surrounding 20-26 range); Berserk correctly level-gated at Lv1 (expected). Commits 7726675/8fb966c/8d642fa/bcb1daf.

⚓ ☃
title: Real effects for Berserk/Boost/Sneak Attack job abilities (Phase 1, §0.5 fixes)
